parameters.content:
## Questions

App sends excerpts it has already read from Postgres. n8n writes the questions a panel would ask and hands them back.

### The examiner lives in Build Prompt

Wording, tone and difficulty mix are all in that Code node. Edit them here on the canvas, no redeploy.

### Scope changes the panel

`chapter` / `proposal` / `final`. A proposal panel must not ask about findings that do not exist yet - that is handled in the SCOPES map.

### Excerpt order is load-bearing

The model cites excerpts by number and the app maps those back to chunk ids **by position**. Never reorder or drop excerpts in Build Prompt.

### Turn off execution saving

Workflow Settings, save successful production executions **off**. Otherwise every run stores a copy of the student's project text.
